name: Streaming Accountability Disclosures By Queensland Local Government Councils 1997  D994749696
text: Accountability Disclosures by Queensland Local Government Councils: 1997–1999 presents the following source proposition: In Australia, anecdotal evidence suggests the quality of annual reports is variable. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Mandatory reporting does not guarantee informative reporting: anecdotal evidence indicates that advisers can present the information required in Forms ADV and PF in ways that in effect flatten out and sanitize the disclosures. The proposed response is an agreement: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
